<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>RBI liquidity intervention:</strong> The Reserve Bank of India announced plans to drain ₹1 lakh crore from the banking system via Open Market Operation (OMO) bond sales to manage a surplus exceeding ₹11 lakh crore.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE9rcmU2SDYtZnk3MUtDZWJxd1VxaDhmVTJPbnpKUGFxV2hfeHBUSmhWS1dQM1NCcXFsdVllRUJmMEFSU1JwLWdVY1FVc3ZpU2UwazdlTm9XMURWa2JKQ0tMOHI3ejdDSnRXRWN1bFpuaFNrRUhXa3I0SQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>NSE IPO impact:</strong> The National Stock Exchange set its IPO price band at ₹1,700–₹1,785, with the issue opening September 17; the announcement contributed to a 3% decline in BSE shares.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxQWmFtNHNtbHBXV1ZTNmRIUXJON3ViN2hMcmtzb3MwTzZyMm9JNThtQWtvNTk4aU04ckRvNjNYN0JOczdGOU5QTndQaFZ5dmlIdWE4eVRHRmtQYUNnVmZLcmR3eU1yRlphN2RfMjg0OWpTVDFGaGo0SXVHMmxkc0hLbUJDWS1BRDA2Z1NyM0ExSm9Ec1E5bFlfRFB2VDZubE1rWGdfQ0RJWGc?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I18</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxOTjhIUzk2VXF5NVhHQTU4ckdaQ1VwUWtadjNSdjBOa2JyckEtUjlyMnl0Tkp5WjZlNmV1RzJTSnZJVTB3Tl9hX0ZTeUVQTVU5emZ4UTJ5aWpwckZneGtLNjV4YThWOFlCeGs3VWNXbDhWSE1EeUxxcGRFWnNrLUprY3pZdlJzalVZWXdSMWRJTkFUSkdPWU1tS2kxVE0tNFVsSEdhTGJubw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I20</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Crude oil volatility:</strong> Indian indices saw a broad-based sell-off, with the Sensex and Nifty sliding nearly 1% as Brent crude prices surged above $108 per barrel, a four-month high.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxNSm9SdUxnbmlKcFE0cmdVRlRJQ2tfN0hMLVJaaFZCb0szWHJ2YUpVd2ZheEhNYWlCdV9ibkppU2ZRY25Sb1o3c1VUWG1ZSHFxbWNiZEllc3hvelpOU1pENU02WVZ4S3VsLUlUSGdPazNwckFweUxwb3lBZ1kxQ2wzaktCZDlaUjIxWnAzLVNyTQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W14</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Rising bond yields:</strong> India’s 10-year bond yield surpassed the 7% mark, pressured by the combination of rising domestic oil prices and elevated US Treasury yields.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxQa3dZd3dqSVJVOUUzekNoU29rSktKT3hxZ0FLVmtwdDFscVhBS3pyNjN2R3NCSjB1TjhEeXZDR283VXZfNkF5WnJZWnd1Q0VfMnJ5czFmUUF0SkFjZnlwR1ZhNEo4a2VkYi1tdk94T1hzTGVWZDRINENZZ3JLSHhKYkprNi00X0M1Vy1SNmNJZzJQVnlXZTVBeFNmU2EyWmgyTlNUejBQOA?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W21</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W22</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W23</a></span></li>
